inspectedText: A vibration mode describes spatial motion. Nodes separate oppositely moving regions. In plate-resonance experiments grains bounce in moving regions and remain near nodes. Added magnets changed the measured system, demonstrating why setup matters. Plate patterns are distinct from an air-pressure waveform.
